name: pathfinder
description: PathFinder — Intent-Aware Explainable Hybrid Retrieval System for people search

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && uv --directory apps/api run ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && uv --directory apps/api run pytest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && uv --directory apps/api run mypy app
scripts.openapi: pnpm --filter web exec openapi-typescript http://localhost:8000/openapi.json -o types/api.d.ts
